coffees.name: Espresso
coffees.description: A rich, full-bodied coffee brewed by forcing hot water through finely-ground coffee beans.

coffees.name: Americano
coffees.description: Espresso diluted with hot water, resulting in a lighter flavor and larger cup.

coffees.name: Cappuccino
coffees.description: A balanced combination of espresso, steamed milk, and milk foam, often topped with cocoa powder.

coffees.name: Latte
coffees.description: A smooth and creamy beverage made with espresso and steamed milk, with a light layer of foam.

coffees.name: Turkish Coffee
coffees.description: Finely ground coffee simmered in a cezve pot and served unfiltered for a thick, aromatic experience.

coffees.name: Cold Brew
coffees.description: Coffee steeped in cold water for an extended period, resulting in a smooth and low-acid beverage.
